q: What underlying challenge does the chapter frame around population and land use?
options: Both population and available arable land are increasing at roughly the same rate
Population is increasing while arable land is decreasing
Arable land has essentially no meaningful relationship to global food production
Population is decreasing while the amount of available arable land is increasing
explain: Population is increasing and arable land is decreasing, raising the question of how to feed a growing population with less land available for food production.

q: What kinds of careers are described as being in high demand to address this challenge?
options: Careers concentrated primarily in the retail and hospitality sectors
Careers in agriculture, AI, and technology
Careers focused mainly on finance and investment banking
Careers that are entirely unrelated to any STEM field
explain: Careers in agriculture, AI, and technology are in high demand and need knowledgeable people who are motivated to solve this problem.

q: According to the chapter, how can a student build soft skills now?
options: Soft skills can only be meaningfully developed after entering a career
By deliberately avoiding group projects and collaborative class activities
By taking leadership roles in class projects or clubs
Only by first completing a full four-year college degree
explain: You can boost your soft skills by taking leadership roles in class projects or clubs.

q: What are some accessible ways mentioned to learn about agriculture before starting a career?
options: Taking agriculture classes, going on farm tours, or getting a summer job at an agriculture company
There is no realistic way to learn about agriculture before starting a career
Only by personally owning and operating a working farm
Only through completing a graduate-level agricultural degree
explain: You can learn about agriculture by taking agriculture classes, going on farm tours, or getting a job at an agriculture company over the summer.

q: Why are data analysis skills described as valuable?
options: They have little practical relevance to agriculture or AI-related careers
They are needed to understand large amounts of data
They are only useful for careers that fall entirely outside of STEM
They fully replace the need for developing any other professional skill
explain: Data analysis skills are also very valuable and needed to understand large amounts of data.

q: How might genetics knowledge be useful in a data science career, as described in the chapter?
options: Genetics knowledge has essentially no application within data science work
It is described as being useful strictly for careers in medicine
It is useful to know as a data scientist working with genetic data
It is said to fully replace the need for programming skills
explain: Skills and knowledge in genetics are useful to know as a data scientist working with genetic data.

q: How might mechanical engineering knowledge be useful to an agronomist, as described in the chapter?
options: It is described as not being relevant to the field of agronomy
It is only described as being useful for designing and building bridges
It is useful when designing studies implementing new technology
It is said to fully replace the need for agricultural knowledge
explain: Mechanical engineering knowledge is useful when designing studies implementing new technology.
